source: BMRC MRE Chapter Routing Guide for NI 43-101 Technical Reports (2026-06-16)

items.title: Summary
gather_fields: Project overview, resource/reserve statement, economics, key risks, and recommendations.
items.dd_question: Is this project viable at a high level?

items.title: Introduction
gather_fields: Report terms, issuer identity, QP identity, effective date, and site visit details.
items.dd_question: Who prepared the report and is the QP qualified for this commodity?

items.title: Reliance on Other Experts
gather_fields: Legal, tenure, tax, environment, and permitting reliance statements.
items.dd_question: Are there unverified assumptions from non-geological experts?

items.title: Property Description and Location
gather_fields: Tenure, ownership, royalties, NSR, government interest, permits, and encumbrances.
items.dd_question: Is tenure secure? What royalties and encumbrances apply?

items.title: Accessibility, Climate, Infrastructure
gather_fields: Roads, rail, port, power, water, climate, labour, and logistics.
items.dd_question: Are infrastructure constraints underestimated?

items.title: History
gather_fields: Historical ownership, exploration, production, and historical estimates.
items.dd_question: Is historical data being relied upon without proper verification?

items.title: Geological Setting and Mineralization
gather_fields: Regional/local geology, host rocks, alteration, mineralization style, and controls.
items.dd_question: Is the geological model sound and the deposit well understood?

items.title: Deposit Types
gather_fields: Genetic model and analogue deposit type.
items.dd_question: Is the deposit type correctly identified? Are the analogues appropriate?

items.title: Exploration
gather_fields: Mapping, geochemistry, geophysics, trenching, and sampling.
items.dd_question: Is there genuine exploration upside beyond the defined resource?

items.title: Drilling
gather_fields: Drill type, spacing, orientation, recovery, survey, and intercept quality.
items.dd_question: Is the database sufficient for the reported classification?

items.title: Sample Preparation, Analyses and Security
gather_fields: Lab, method, QAQC program, CRM/blank/duplicate rates, and security.
items.dd_question: Is the assay data reliable and the QAQC protocol fit for purpose?

items.title: Data Verification
gather_fields: QP validation, database integrity, site visit, and independent checks.
items.dd_question: Has an independent QP validated the database?

items.title: Mineral Processing and Metallurgical Testing
gather_fields: Testwork, ore types, recovery, process route, and deleterious elements.
items.dd_question: Are the recovery assumptions supported by adequate testwork?

items.title: Mineral Resource Estimates
gather_fields: Resource statement, cut-off, estimation method, variography, classification, and density.
items.dd_question: Is the resource estimate defensible and correctly classified?

items.title: Mineral Reserve Estimates
gather_fields: Reserve statement, modifying factors, cut-off, and Proven/Probable split.
items.dd_question: Is the reserve conversion ratio and modifying factor set reasonable?

items.title: Mining Methods
gather_fields: Pit/UG design, dilution, recovery, geotech, and production schedule.
items.dd_question: Is the mining method and schedule realistic for this deposit?

items.title: Recovery Methods
gather_fields: Processing plant, flowsheet, throughput, recovery, and reagents.
items.dd_question: Is the processing design appropriate for the ore type?

items.title: Project Infrastructure
gather_fields: Roads, power, water, tailings, waste dump, port, and logistics.
items.dd_question: Are infrastructure costs fully scoped and risks identified?

items.title: Market Studies and Contracts
gather_fields: Payability, concentrate terms, product pricing, and offtake contracts.
items.dd_question: Are price, payability, and TC/RC assumptions reasonable?

items.title: Environmental Studies, Permitting and Social Impact
gather_fields: Baseline, permits, closure, community, ESG, and resettlement.
items.dd_question: Are permitting and ESG risks adequately characterised?

items.title: Capital and Operating Costs
gather_fields: CAPEX, OPEX, cost basis, accuracy class, and contingencies.
items.dd_question: Do costs reflect study-stage accuracy and peer benchmarks?

items.title: Economic Analysis
gather_fields: NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity, discount rate, tax, and royalty.
items.dd_question: Are the economic assumptions appropriate and the NPV defensible?

items.title: Adjacent Properties
gather_fields: Nearby deposits and mines, and analogues.
items.dd_question: What do adjacent projects tell us about geological risk and opportunity?

items.title: Other Relevant Data and Information
gather_fields: Project-specific technical material.
items.dd_question: Is there additional technical data relevant to the investment?

items.title: Interpretation and Conclusions
gather_fields: QP conclusions, risks, confidence, and project materiality.
items.dd_question: What are the QP's own stated risks and confidence limitations?

items.title: Recommendations
gather_fields: Work program, budget, and next-stage studies.
items.dd_question: What does the QP say is required before the next study stage?

items.title: References
gather_fields: Source reports and citations.
items.dd_question: Are references credible, current, and properly cited?

extract: Royalties and net smelter return interests.
compare: Compare tenure conditions with similar projects in the same country or region.

5.search: Item 5: Accessibility, Climate, Local Resources, Infrastructure and Physiography.
compare: Compare infrastructure with projects in similar geographic settings.

7-8.search: Item 7: Geological Setting and Mineralization; Item 8: Deposit Types.
compare: Search and rank analogues by deposit type, commodity, host rock, mineralisation style.
Assess whether drilling supports Measured, Indicated and Inferred classification.

11-12.search: Item 11: Sample Preparation, Analyses and Security; Item 12: Data Verification.
compare: Compare protocols with similar NI 43-101 projects.
flag: Heavy reliance on unverified historical data.

13-17.search: Item 13: Mineral Processing and Metallurgical Testing; Item 17: Recovery Methods.
compare: Benchmark against commodity, ore type, deposit type, processing route.
flag: High recovery based on limited testing.

compare: Benchmark cut-off grade, estimation method, classification criteria against peers.

15-16.search: Item 15: Mineral Reserve Estimates; Item 16: Mining Methods.
compare: Benchmark reserve conversion, dilution, mining recovery against peers.

19-21-22.search: Item 19: Market Studies; Item 21: Capital and Operating Costs; Item 22: Economic Analysis.
compare: Compare peer projects by commodity, country, mining method, study stage.

20.search: Item 20: Environmental Studies, Permitting and Social or Community Impact.
compare: Compare with similar projects in the same jurisdiction.

25-26.search: Item 25: Interpretation and Conclusions; Item 26: Recommendations.
compare: Assess report tone: conservative, balanced, or promotional.
flag: Risks disclosed in body but omitted from conclusions.
Overly positive language unsupported by data.

benchmark_templates.name: Cut-off Grade Benchmarking
benchmark_templates.output_format: typical range, median, outliers, reasonableness assessment

benchmark_templates.name: Open-Pit Cut-off Grade Reasonableness
benchmark_templates.output_format: peer comparison table and reasonableness verdict

benchmark_templates.name: Technical Red Flag Detection
benchmark_templates.output_format: list of red flags with evidence

core_dd_questions: What are the closest NI 43-101 analogues for this project?
What cut-off grades are used by comparable projects?
Are the metal price assumptions reasonable compared with peer reports?
Are recovery assumptions supported by comparable metallurgy?
Is the Mineral Resource classification justified by drill spacing and continuity?
Is the Reserve conversion ratio reasonable?
Are dilution and mining recovery assumptions realistic?
Are CAPEX and OPEX within peer range?
Is the selected mining method appropriate for the geometry?
Is the selected processing route appropriate for ore type?
Are deleterious elements properly tested and modelled?
Are density assumptions adequate and representative?
Are QAQC results sufficient for resource reporting?
Are there unresolved historical data risks?
Are there environmental or permitting risks common to this jurisdiction?
What are the main technical red flags compared with peer reports?
What assumptions are aggressive or unsupported?
What additional data is required before investment decision?
Is the project consistent with a PEA, PFS, FS, or investment-grade standard?
Should the project be classified as Go, Conditional Go, Further Work, or No-Go?

metadata_schema.report_item: Item number and section title (e.g. Item 14 Mineral Resource Estimates)
metadata_schema.commodity: Cu, Au, Zn, Pb, Ag, Ni, Li, REE
metadata_schema.study_stage: Exploration, MRE, PEA, PFS, FS, operating
metadata_schema.cutoff_type: Grade cut-off, NSR cut-off, pit shell
